npc:3389.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

npc:3403.text: Da spirits be strong wit you, mon. What kin dis troll do for ya?

npc:3433.text: The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.$B$BHe feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

npc:3615.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

npc:4488.text: It's always nice when someone wishes to speak to me. How are things with you, $c?
Now, answer me this, $n:$BWhich creature became the Lich King before spreading the plague across Lordaeron?

npc:4489.text: Greetings, $c. Is there something I can help you with?
My question to you is this, $c:$BWhich of the Aspects created by the titans became the nefarious creature known as Deathwing?

npc:4551.text: How may I be of service?

npc:4556.text: Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.

npc:4593.text: The warrior's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

npc:514.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

npc:5564.text: Randal's a bit of a dandy, but he's dependable, which is more than I can say for a lot of the students I take on. Still, I guess I can't blame them for wanting a bit of adventure.

npc:6491.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

npc:6929.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

npc:7854.text: Welcome to Camp Mojache, brave $c.  How may I assist you this day?

npc:8962.text: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

npc:8965.text: Hello there $g mister : ma'am;... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

npc:10537.text: We cannot take care of all the threats in this area alone. We could use another fighting hand, $N.

npc:2055.text: The Royal Apothecary Society shall heed The Dark Lady's call to uncover the New Plague and drive Arthas and his heathen Scourge Army from the world once and for all.

npc:2215.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

npc:2216.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

npc:2410.text: My studies take me far from the Under City, but to truly learn one must be near to the source of knowledge.

npc:3446.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

npc:381.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

npc:415.text: Hey buddy, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

npc:4877.text: Hail, friend. Can I interest you in any of my trade supplies?

meta.attribution: Data from Efficient Games (https://efficient.games), licensed under CC BY 4.0.

complete.text: Well done, $N. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!

progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.

complete.text: Heh, so old Verner needs some shoes, does he!?!

progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!

accept.text: Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...$B$BHere they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!

complete.text:
Thank you, this really helps me out.

But what's this?  Argus sent a note with the crate...What??  Argus wants me to PAY him?  Bah!

Well, $N, thank you for your help.

objectives.text: Return to Verner Osgood in Redridge.  Give him the Crate of Horseshoes.

progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?

accept.text: I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire.  If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.$B$BBlack dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander.  You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.

complete.text: Thanks!  These will get me out of debt to Argus...

objectives.text: Gather 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales from Black Dragon Whelps, and bring them to Verner Osgood in Redridge.

progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?

accept.text: As if the attacking orcs weren't enough!  Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...$B$BIf you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.

complete.text: Thank you for all your help, $N.

objectives.text: Kill 10 Redridge Brutes and 8 Redridge Mystics, then return to Verner Osgood.

accept.text: $n, the gnolls are still out there.  I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire.  And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler,  their leader.$B$BKill Yowler and send his pack scattering!  Bring me his paw as proof.$B$BAnd be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason.  He is no Mongrel...

objectives.text: Bring Yowler's Paw to Verner Osgood in Lakeshire.

complete.text: Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!

progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?

accept.text: The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes.$b$bMagistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.

objectives.text: Kill 15 Blackrock Champions and Guard Howe in Lakeshire will reward you.

accept.text: Murlocs are becoming a problem.  Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm!  We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!$B$BHunt murlocs!  Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...

complete.text:
Well done, $N.  I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.

It's strange seeing them so far from the sea.  I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...

objectives.text: Bring 8 Murloc Fins to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.

progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!

accept.text: Mug'Thol and his ogre warband was sent to Alterac to retrieve the Crown of Will for Lady Sylvanas. Unfortunately, instead of returning it, the idiot decided to try it on... I suppose ogres can't resist anything bright and shiny.$b$bHis bumbling actions have become something of a problem, however. The Crown of Will enabled him to resist the possession placed upon him to serve Lady Sylvanas.$b$bThe Dark Lady wants an example made, travel to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad and report to Melisara, my lieutenant.

objectives.text: Report to Melisara at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

complete.text: You pour some of the elixir into your hand and hold it before Stanley's mouth.

progress.text: Woof?

accept.text: Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out.  They seem bent on killing each other as is.$b$bAlas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?$b$bHere's the plan, $n: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.

complete.text: Ah, the horrible reek of Mudsnout Blossoms.  At least those filthy Gnolls are good for something.

objectives.text: Bring 6 Mudsnout Blossoms to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

progress.text: Any luck at Nethander Stead?

accept.text: Just when I thought another day was going to pass devoid of any joy, you brought me those marvelous Mudsnout Blossoms.$b$bFirst I will mix them down into a fine composite.  We'll then need Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity to apply his colloid of decay to it and then we'll be ready for some good fun indeed!$b$bHere, take this Mudsnout Composite and run it off to Master Faranell at once, $n.

complete.text:
Apothecary Lydon sent you?  Ah, why didn't you say so!

Despite his gloomy disposition, Apothecary Lydon is one of our most dedicated and skilled members.

The good chap sends Mudsnout Composite!  I know what our friend in Hillsbrad is up to now.  And I like the way he thinks.  The Dark Lady would be most impressed with the progress he is making toward the new plague.

objectives.text: Take the Mudsnout Composite to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

progress.text: Can you not see I am busy, $c?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!

accept.text: A mudsnout composite?  Absolutely brilliant!  Why didn't I think of that?$b$bLet me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.$b$bIn order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood elixir, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad.  He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents.  And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!

objectives.text: Bring the Mudsnout Mixture, a Strong Troll's Blood Elixir, 5 Daggerspine Scales and 5 Torn Fin Eyes to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

accept.text: Stand at attention while addressing me, $c.$b$bI am under direct command of Varimathras.  We are to quell the human infestation until our apothecaries can develop the new plague.$b$bOur information leads us to believe that the town of Hillsbrad is vulnerable to attack.  Your first assignment is aimed at disrupting their food supply and infrastructure.$b$bTravel west.  Raid the northernmost farms of Hillsbrad Fields.  Make sure that the landowners, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz, are executed as well.

objectives.text: Kill 6 Hillsbrad Farmhands, 6 Hillsbrad Farmers, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

complete.text:
You have done a great service for the Forsaken, $N. These artifacts have been sorely missed.

And it is good to hear that Kegan and the other betrayers have found justice.

progress.text: Did you find the thieves? And more importantly, did you find what they stole?

accept.text: Before it mysteriously vanished, there was an enormous magical barrier around the newly-reconstructed city of Dalaran. I care not what caused such a magical marvel to fail, but I do care that the newly exposed outskirts of their city may hide valuable magical treasures. Vestiges of the ruins on which the new city is built. $B$BBut the area is patrolled by the wizards and their elemental slaves.$B$BSo hunt them, and return when their numbers are sufficiently reduced.

complete.text:
Very good. Thank you, $N.

Now we are free to pay Dalaran a little visit.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Dalaran Summoners and $2oa Elemental Slaves, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

accept.text: High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance.  I had set up camp just out of sight.  But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood.$b$bWhen I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing.$b$bApparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it.  I need my sword!  If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful.  So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.

complete.text:
You found it!

Ah, I feel so complete with my precious sword back in my hand.  Many thanks to you!

objectives.text: Retrieve Deathguard Humbert's sword from Dun Garok and return it to him in Tarren Mill.

progress.text: Were you able to retrieve my sword, $N?  High Executor Darthalia will hang me from the rafters if she discovers my folly.

accept.text: By the authority of Lady Sylvanas, all members of the organization known as the Syndicate are wanted dead. Those brought into custody or taken prisoner will be summarily executed. They are currently known to be amassing in the ruins of Durnholde Keep, to the southeast of Tarren Mill.$b$bA handsome reward is offered to all who bring proof of their deeds to High Executor Darthalia.

objectives.text: Kill 10 Syndicate Rogues and 10 Syndicate Watchmen. Return to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill for your reward.

accept.text: Master Helcular was almost complete with his transformation into a Lich when a human lynch mob discovered his ritual lair in the hills and brutally killed him.  To make matters worse they buried his corpse in the Southshore cemetery.$b$bSuch disregard for the great wizard is unacceptable.  As his apprentice I shall see to it that the rains of vengeance fall upon the town of Southshore.$b$bWe will need Helcular's Rod first.  Yeti overtook his ritual lair.  Undoubtedly one of the beasts has it.

complete.text: You found it!  Most excellent, $N!

objectives.text: Retrieve Helcular's Rod from the Yeti and bring it back to Novice Thaivand in Tarren Mill.

progress.text: Have you recovered Helcular's Rod yet?  There are so many Yeti in this region, it will be very difficult to locate.  But we must have it in order to proceed.

accept.text: Here, take the Rod of Helcular. You will need it.$b$bHelcular fashioned 3 ceremonial pyres as part of his most powerful spell.  The Flame of Azel and the Flame of Veraz lie within the Foothill Caverns. The Flame of Uzel lies in a cave above the caverns, further north in the mountains.$b$bThe Rod of Helcular must be charged from each of the three flames. Once the ritual is complete, drive the rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore, the heavily guarded human town to the south.  Vengeance shall be ours!

complete.text: A great rumbling emanates from the ground.

objectives.text: Charge the Rod of Helcular with the powers of the Flame of Azel, Flame of Veraz and the Flame of Uzel.$b$bDrive the charged rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore.

progress.text: Helcular's grave teems with a mystical energy.

accept.text: A notable talent of the wizards of Dalaran is their familiarity with elementals: powerful creatures from other dimensions.  The wizards use magical tokens as a means to control these elementals.  Magus Voidglare would like some of these tokens to study.$B$BEnter the territories of the Dalaran wizards, west of Hillsbrad, and gather the tokens.$B$BYou might find the tokens on any citizen of Dalaran, but I suggest hunting at the internment camp.  It's safer than Dalaran itself.

complete.text:
These will do nicely.  Although it looks like their magic is faded, it would be best if the Magus' initial experiments were on inert specimens such as these.

Thank you, $N.

objectives.text: Bring 10 Worn Stone Tokens to Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill.

progress.text: Do you have the Worn Stone Tokens, $N?  The Magus is eager to unlock their secrets.

accept.text: The Magus will be busy studying those stone tokens you gathered, but I know he'll eventually want examples of their counterpart: bracers of binding.  These are set around the wrists of actual elementals, and bind them into the mage's service.$B$BHunt elementals in the ruins of Dalaran and gather their Bracers of Earth Binding, and the Magus will be pleased.

complete.text:
You found them.  I trust the elementals from which you removed these bracers were amenable?

Hm...death has not only stopped my heart, but robbed me of my comedic timing, it seems.

Well thank you, $N.  You serve the Magus, and hence the Dark Lady, well.

objectives.text: Bring 4 Bracers of Earth Binding to Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill.

progress.text: Hello, $N.  Elementals are tough quarry, but I know you're up to the task.  Do you have those bracers of binding?

complete.text: You are quite the bounty hunter, $c.  Well done.

accept.text: This shard pulses as you hold it...$B$BYou feel a sense of pleading coming from the shard, as if someone is trying to communicate, someone who desperately needs your help.$B$BA vision appears in your mind - of the northern mountains of Arathi, and of a brilliant crystal jutting from the earth there.$B$BYou feel drawn to that place.

objectives.text: Find the crystal from your vision.

accept.text: Weaklings... all of them. You, $c, what are you looking at? Think you're something special, huh? Why not prove it?$B$BThe Hammerfall outpost in Arathi's under attack. Unless we send them help soon, their demise is imminent.$B$BBut before you go rushing off, you may want to test your skills first. Northeast of Stromgarde in Arathi is an ogre mound inhabited by the Boulderfist tribe. When you can handle the ogres and enforcers there, then report to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.

objectives.text: Kill 8 Boulderfist Ogres and 10 Boulderfist Enforcers, then find Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost in Arathi Highlands.

accept.text: Whilst the Dark Lady tends to the pressing issue of the Lich King's advance to the north, I am seeing to it that matters closer to home are being taken care of accordingly.$b$bNo doubt, the human pests who call themselves the Scarlet Crusade are proving to be the sharpest thorn in our side domestically. Tirisfal Glades is literally crawling with the little red ants.$b$bTravel to the Monastery, $c, and lay waste to High Inquisitor Whitemane and her top lieutenants.

objectives.text: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Varimathras in the Undercity.

accept.text: The Earthen Ring had pure intentions towards our plagued brethren. But who is to know the motivations of those whispering in the ears of the Elder Council?$b$bThe Forsaken whom we have allied with have a history wrought with deceit. Too hasty was our pact. Perhaps Cairne would have been wise to heed the warnings from Orgrimmar.$b$bDeep within the Scarlet Monastery lies the Compendium of the Fallen, guarded by crazed human zealots. Their method is forged from insanity but their research might prove useful.

complete.text:
The Compendium of the Fallen! I was beginning to wonder if the very book existed!

You have served the tauren of Thunder Bluff well, $N. Your dedication shall not be forgotten.

objectives.text: Retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and return to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.

progress.text:
Cairne is a brave and noble leader and I would trust him with my own life. But it is others that I do not trust in this political climate.

Once I have a chance to gather all the knowledge available I can provide sound council to the Chieftain.

Have you had a chance to travel to Tirisfal Glades? To the Scarlet Monastery? The Compendium of the Fallen is just one piece in this complicated puzzle...

accept.text: Even though my will is free, I can serve the Dark Lady no more. I feel my time on Azeroth has come to an end. My life force is shattered.$b$bInterrogator Vishas did this to me! Tortured me for weeks! Took my wedding ring and gave it to his wife. The bastard!$b$bRevenge... I want revenge!$b$bThe pompous fool bragged about his precious wife, Nancy, who lived along Lake Lordamere. Track the wench down, slay her and return my wedding ring to my wife, Monika in Tarren Mill.$b$bHeed my last wishes....

objectives.text: Return Vorrel Sengutz's wedding ring to Monika Sengutz in Tarren Mill.

accept.text: Cairne is a noble leader for uniting our people here on Thunder Bluff.$b$bBut I cannot forgive those who drove us from our ancestral lands as easily as some. My people inhabited the southern Barrens for decades. The land was holy to us. But we were driven off by numerous foes.$b$bA vengeful fate awaits the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who musters a foul army from within Razorfen Kraul.$b$bBring me Razorflank's heart and I can die in peace, $n.

complete.text:
I see the nasty tribe of Razorfen Kraul now knows the pain of my people. Serves the foul beasts right.

To drive one from a holy land is a sin worthy of the most severe revenge.

Thank you, $N, for aiding me in my plight.

objectives.text: Bring Razorflank's Heart to Auld Stonespire in Thunder Bluff.

progress.text:
Once I know the foul beasts of Razorfen Kraul have been driven from their foul lair, I will be able to rest in peace, knowing that revenge has been served.

Have you the driven the quilboar from the Kraul? Do you bring to me good news in the form of Razorflank's heart?

accept.text: As you can see, $n, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society.$b$bAs the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time!$b$bYou look well traveled for a $c. Perhaps you can aid me.$b$bI'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...

complete.text: Splendid! This is just the start we needed, $N.

objectives.text: Bring 1 pile of Kraul Guano to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

progress.text: Ah, I see you have returned. Were you able to procure any Kraul Guano?

accept.text: Why do I need a rare type of guano, you might ask. Well, for this experiment I want to see what effect two diametrically opposed chemical substances can have on each other, especially when both are combined with an ever-toxic agent to ensure the most... ghastly results.$b$bIn the northeastern peaks of Tirisfal Glades lies the Scarlet Monastery. There the crazed disciples of the Scarlet Crusade congregate. Slay them and bring me their zealous hearts.$b$bOur concoction will be most wicked!

complete.text: My what an abundance of gore you have brought me, $N! Your efforts have been most excellent!

objectives.text: Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity wants 20 Hearts of Zeal.

progress.text:
Have you returned from the Scarlet Monastery? I'll need many hearts for this delightful experiment!

No doubt, Varimathras and the Dark Lady will be pleased to be rid of the Scarlet Scum as well...

complete.text:
In defeating the creature Steelsnap, you have cleansed the Thousand Needles of a horrible taint.

And that, $N, is your lesson this day.

progress.text: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, $N?

accept.text: $n, it is now time for you to travel to far-off lands.  You are ready.$B$BYou now hunt Frostmaw, a yeti in the Alterac Mountains.  He is elusive, his white coat blending into the snows of his mountain home.  He rarely shows himself.$B$BBut I will show you how to entice a creature such as he.  Here, take this scroll.  On it I have written how Frostmaw may be lured.$B$BNow go, $n.  Your journey is long and many challenges lay waiting.  When you return with Frostmaw's mane, only then is your task complete.

complete.text:
Both strength and cunning were needed to find and defeat Frostmaw, $N.  You have both.

Your path has taken you to the valleys of Thousand Needles and to the high mountains of Alterac.  It will one day lead you through all the Earthmother's lands, for such is the way of the hunter.

objectives.text: Bring Frostmaw's Mane to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

progress.text: Have you been to the Alterac Mountains, $N?  Did you face the elusive Frostmaw?

complete.text: Thanks again, friend! I told you I'd make it worth your while.

accept.text: Many travelers who've come through the Crossroads helped me gather eggs from the Field of Giants, and many of them have tales of how deadly the creatures are. I've heard enough to consider them insects a much larger threat than my masters first thought.$B$BI need a courier to travel to Orgrimmar to meet Belgrom Rockmaul. It be no simple matter, and someone who would take the task seriously should go.$B$BBelgrom usually be found outside the warriors' guild house.

objectives.text: Deliver Korran's Sealed Note to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

accept.text:
So, you have sought me out, or perhaps destiny brings you to me? No matter. You are here now, and so your journey will begin anew.

Many facets make up a being: the spirit, the body, the mind. Some of these can be measured by a culture's traditions. Others we can only hope exist within ourselves. If you agree, I shall test some of the facets within you.

If you pass, then you shall become stronger. If you fail, then you will realize the vastness of the Nether.

The first is a Test of Faith.

complete.text:
It is not until faced with unforeseen adversity that we begin to see how strong our spirits are. You took the leap of faith even though you had no guarantees that you would survive. Your mind is open, and your spirit is prepared for what is to come.

If you are willing, then the next of your tests is ready.

objectives.text: If you have faith, leap from the planks overlooking Thousand Needles.

accept.text:
I'm pleased to see your courage remains steadfast in light of what you've already done. Since your faith is intact, the time has come to test your body.

First is a test of endurance. Go with friends to the Roguefeather Den west of Freewind Post. Make your way to the depths of their lair and destroy their foodstuffs. By then you should have provoked their fury, and if you are able to survive long enough, Grenka Bloodscreech herself will come for you--kill her and bring me her claw to complete your test.

complete.text:
Grenka was powerful, even by $r standards. You should be proud of your accomplishment this day.

During your test of faith you displayed strength of spirit, and now you have shown endurance in battle by taking on the Roguefeather harpies, but the time has come for a new test.

objectives.text: Bring Grenka's Claw to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

progress.text:
You must be prepared spiritually, physically and mentally for the challenges that lie ahead of you.

Too often do we rush forward before we are ready. I consider it my duty to the youth, no matter which tribe they belong to, to prepare them for the dangers they may face after they leave the sanctity of their home.

accept.text: During the time of the Old Gods, elementals inhabited much of this world. They worshipped the Old Gods, and the Gods, through their power, kept the elementals bound to this world. When the Old Gods were banished, the elementals faded from our world and now only return at the bidding of powerful mages.$B$BThere are exceptions though. Some elementals were powerful enough to remain here on their own. One such elemental is Rok'Alim.$B$BTo test your strength, find Rok'Alim in Thousand Needles and slay him.

complete.text: The Test of Strength is done. You have shown strength and bravery, and you are now prepared for the final test before these rites are completed.

objectives.text: Bring Fragments of Rok'Alim to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

progress.text: Rok'Alim is also called the Pounder by the centaur tribes in Thousand Needles because of the thundering his fists make as he pummels the creatures brave, or stupid, enough to stand in his path.

accept.text: Your time with me is just about finished. I am knowledgeable, but the Test of Lore is not mine to give. There are lessons to be learned and places to visit that others claim domain over.$B$BIf you are prepared, then seek out Braug Dimspirit--he is a shaman of great wisdom. He will test you further, so heed his words, $n.$B$BWhen you are ready, find the tunnel that connects the Stonetalon Mountains with Ashenvale: Braug dwells near there. And be careful, $n, the night elves may wish to impede your test.

complete.text:
The days and nights grow colder throughout the world as goblins rape the land, and the night elves point fingers at the younger races. The Forsaken and orcs are not the only ones to blame for the hardships found throughout Kalimdor and Lordaeron. Many of the intelligent races have contributed to the world's pain. Dorn knows this, and he has sent you to me because you have shown the attributes necessary to realize it also.

Now you stand before Braug.

objectives.text: Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.

complete.text:
A good sample, $N. A good sample indeed.

Those travelers can no longer lord over me the ore they found, now that you have been successful.

I shall get to work on it immediately. If it proves strong enough, I will send a weapon crafted from the material back to the warchief to show him our success.

I shall not forget your help, $c.

progress.text:
I saw the travelers again--the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.

accept.text: You have passed Dorn's tests, and now you seek to pass your next trial. Very good. But up until now, your challenges have been childish. It is easy to test your body--your mind is another matter completely.$B$BI shall explain it simply: find the book I name, study it, and answer my question about its contents.$B$BWhat book, you must be asking? The Legacy of the Aspects. It can be found at the bottom of Dor'danil in southern Ashenvale, protected by the dead druids and their slayers.

complete.text:
This is the book I named. There is hope you will answer my question correctly then... unless you've forgotten to study its contents.

When you are prepared, speak to me again and I shall ask a question of you.

objectives.text: Find the Legacy of the Aspects and return it to Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.

progress.text: Bring me the book after you've studied it. I will not ask you your question until after you have given me the book.

accept.text: Well done, $n. You have passed the first portion of the Test of Lore, but there is still another question to be answered. But that question is not mine to ask.$B$BSeek out Parqual Fintallas in Lordaeron City. He was a great historian for the humans before the Plague overtook him. Now he continues to seek enlightenment, but of a different nature.$B$BHe will have another requirement of you before he asks you anything, but you have done masterfully thus far--I'm sure you will overcome his obstacle.

complete.text:
Braug sent you? Impossible.

<Parqual looks you up and down.>

Braved Dor'Danil, took a leap of faith, fought and overpowered a powerful elemental? Bah! You're probably a farce; some adventurer that overheard talk in a tavern. And now you think you have what it takes to pass my test. So be it... $c.

objectives.text: Find Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.

accept.text: I will tell you what you must seek, and I will even ask you my question, but not because you wish to prove yourself. Knowledge is far more important than strength. Even as others seem to pass you by in ability, your knowledge of the world will be more valuable.$B$BGo to the Monastery in the north of Tirisfal Glades. In the library there, a book called Beginnings of the Undead Threat resides. It was used by the now-corrupt paladins there to train them to fight my kind.$B$BBring it to me.

complete.text:
This is the book I sent you to search for.

<Parqual slowly caresses his hand over the top of the book as he stares down at it.>

So now you wish a question to prove your mind is as powerful as your body and spirit. If you have studied the book long enough, then I shall ask you your question and you can be done with these tests!

objectives.text: Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat, and return it to Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.

progress.text:
I hope you made the Scarlet Crusade suffer some before stealing the book from them.

My views of their kind are not unwarranted. The Crusade may have been followers of the Light at one time, but now, they seek to destroy any creatures that have not sided with their religion. They believe all undead, Forsaken or otherwise, must be cleansed, and those traveling in their lands must either be insane, or subject to the undead's powerful magics. Idiots. Idiots and fools; all of them.

accept.text: The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!$B$BMy family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.$B$BI don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!$B$BKill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.

objectives.text: Bring Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie's Heads to Genavie Callow in Undercity.

complete.text: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.

progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.

accept.text: Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.$b$bI wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.

complete.text: Hm, yes, this phial of water will serve our purposes perfectly. Because of the shared ancestry of the dryads and the centaurs, the water of the moonwells will enable us to breach the protection of the eternal flame surrounding the centaur relic.

objectives.text: Deliver the Filled Etched Phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.

progress.text: I don't suppose you've been sent by Zangen, hm?

accept.text: Using the water you brought, you will be able to temporarily douse the flame that holds the centaur relic. It will not work permanently, however, so you will have to be quick about it.$b$bYou will find Splithoof Crag, the centaurs' stronghold, to the north of here. The flame is kept in Splithoof Hold, a heavily guarded part of the crag.$b$bBe careful, though, the Galak centaur have great numbers here, and will be rather reluctant to surrender something so dear to them.

objectives.text: Retrieve the Cloven Hoof for Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.

accept.text: Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.$B$BAnd even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.$B$BIt won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.

objectives.text: Grab a Crate with Holes.$BGrab a Snufflenose Command Stick.$BGrab and read the Snufflenose Owner's Manual.$B$BIn Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers.$B$BBring 6 Blueleaf Tubers, the Snufflenose Command Stick and the Crate with Holes to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.

complete.text: Yes, I am recruiting.  This mission leads into Desolace, against the centaur there.  I will be brief so that you may quickly begin.

accept.text: The Kolkar centaur live in Desolace, and their forces have spread into the Barrens.  This is a known fact and we have Horde agents dealing with them here.$B$BBut as long as the centaur are strong in Desolace, they will always pose a threat.  It is time we rid ourselves of that threat.$B$BSpeak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.  He was sent to gather intelligence on the centaur.  He will know how to best deal with the Kolkar of Desolace.

objectives.text: Speak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

accept.text: You have done well, $n. You have passed my test, and the tests before mine. Return to Dorn in Thousand Needles. He will sense the change within you, and see that your mind, body and spirit are strong enough that you should be rewarded for your efforts.$B$BStay true to the balance you've shown throughout these trials, $n. Dorn will test you again in the future if you do.

complete.text:
Ah, $N. It has been a long time since you have last stepped into my home. It seems like many moons have passed since you took your first leap that set you upon your path.

And now you return to me stronger than you once were... more enlightened. This pleases me. And you should be justly rewarded for seeing my tests to the end.

objectives.text: Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

complete.text: For the time being, I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.

You have gathered the items for my spell, and have shown me your strength and cunning.  But the next stage of our quest is even more perilous.

Let us hope your strength does not falter.

progress.text: Do you have the items, $N?  Gathering them is the proof I need that you have the strength to face Cyclonian.

accept.text:
I am ready to perform the ritual to summon Cyclonian.  When he is summoned, you must defeat him and take his whirlwind heart.  This I will use to instill a weapon with Cyclonian's power.

$N, are you ready to face the wind lord?

complete.text: You did it!  You defeated Cyclonian and gained the Whirlwind Heart!

objectives.text: Bring the Whirlwind Heart to Bath'rah Windwatcher.

progress.text: $N, I must have the whirlwind heart!

complete.text:
The charms sink slowly into the cauldron's depths...

A large bubble rises to the surface of the liquid and breaks...

...And a churning lump of molten rock is revealed.

progress.text: The cauldron bubbles.  Its vapors beckon...

complete.text:
I have the whirlwind heart, and am ready to place it within your vessel of choice.

Choose your weapon, $N, and know that its power is the power of Cyclonian.

accept.text: Sweeping the bat pens with this broom is not befitting a Garrett!  I've earned a little coin from this accursed job, and I'm willing to spend it on you to better my station.$B$BThe Garrett family weapon of choice is locked away in our chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman from when we Garretts toiled there as diggers.  Without it, I will be stuck here forever - literally - sweeping up after these infernal bats.$B$BReclaim my family's treasure and bring it to me!  Help me restore my birthright!

objectives.text: Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.

complete.text:
You're a tough one! Ridding the Den of Rynthariel is a major step, $N. They will be slow to regroup, and so we can count on less Alliance runners in the Barrens. They will think again before sending another this way.

Thank you.

accept.text: My friend Hilary lost her necklace, and we can't find it.  We've been fishing all day right here, and we looked around here already.  The only thing I can think of is that it fell into the lake.  Our parents don't want us to swim in the lake... my mom says there's some mean things underwater, but you look like you aren't scared of mean things.$B$BCould you find it for her, please?

complete.text: Thank you for finding my necklace mister $c... you are very kind!  My kitty thanks you too - isn't that right Effsee?

objectives.text: Find Hilary's Necklace, and return it to Hilary in Lakeshire.

progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?

accept.text:
I've been tasked to recruit more wyverns for the master wind riders. Their numbers are growing and I myself hope to become a wind rider one day. However, we cannot train enough wyverns to keep up with the demand. Perhaps you can help me, $N.

I need you to travel to Highperch to gather some wyvern eggs. From here, head northwest along the canyon walls to a ramp that will lead you into Highperch. Be careful, wyverns are very protective over their eggs and they will not be kind to intruders.

complete.text: Perfect! With these eggs I hope to take the next step to become a wind rider. Here is a token of my appreciation; may good hunting always shine upon you, $C.

objectives.text: Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.

progress.text: $N, have you retrieved the wyvern eggs that I seek? I'm really anxious to start my wind rider training!

accept.text:
A rumor has surfaced about an alien egg here in Thousand Needles. Those that report seeing this egg have failed to even get close enough to examine it in detail. Serpents guard the egg as if it's one of their own.

I want you to seek out this alien egg and bring it to me so that I may examine it. Reports say the egg is located within a serpent den, but there are several serpent dens along the base of the cliff walls south and northeast of Freewind Post.

complete.text: Yes, finally... the mysterious egg has finally been delivered to me. Now, let me take a closer look at this... What..! What is this..?

objectives.text: Return the Alien Egg to Hagar Lightninghoof in Freewind Post.

progress.text: I must know more about this mysterious egg, who knows what will hatch from it.

complete.text: For my gratitude, this is for you, $N.

accept.text:
If I did not see that with my own eyes I would never have believed it to be true. Vengeance has come to Thousand Needles!

<Hagar wipes his brow.>

$N, you must act quickly! Go now and seek out Motega Firemane; he is located at Whitereach Post just northwest of Freewind Post along the road. He will know what to do!

complete.text: Vengeance! So, the legend of Arikara is true. Indeed, this is a problem that must be resolved immediately.

objectives.text: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.

accept.text:
Arnak thinks we're going to be married... but after I declined his offer he came back that night and kidnapped me. My brother tried to stop him, but Arnak was too strong. He... he slew my brother and then brought me here.  My poor brother...

$N, could you escort me out of the Darkcloud Pinnacle?  Please... I need to get back to Thalia! She must be worried sick about me.

complete.text: Thank you, $N. Deep in my bones I knew that she would find her way back to me. She told me of your bravery and how you helped her escape. These items belonged to her brother. I know she would want you to have them.

objectives.text: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.

accept.text: Arikara is a deadly creature that must be dealt with swiftly. In order to hunt her down you will need to light the sacred fire of life - this will summon Arikara.$B$BGo now and harvest the rare Incendia agave plant. Once you have harvested enough agave, seek council with Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. She is a powerful shaman that can enchant the agave plant to create a powder that will light the fire.$B$BTravel northeast to the Boiling Pool and gather Incendia Agave.

objectives.text: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.

accept.text: $n, you have served us well in the past, so I now entrust to you an important mission. The Grimtotem Clan is up to something secretive. Three agents of unknown origin were seen visiting the Grimtotem over the recent weeks. We discovered that separate chests in Darkcloud Pinnacle hold these guarded messages.$b$b$n, if you succeed in this dangerous mission, I will reward you in kind.

complete.text:
Great Spirit Totem! This is dire news indeed. I must begin to plan for whatever may come.

$N, as promised, here is your reward for your brave service.

objectives.text: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

progress.text: Have you discovered what the Grimtotem are up to?

accept.text: Wanted: Arnak Grimtotem$B$BArnak the outcast is wanted for the heinous crimes of murder and kidnapping. Handsome rewards will be given to those brave enough to bring this criminal to justice.$B$BArnak was last seen on the cliffs near the Darkcloud Pinnacle. Show the proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post in order to claim the reward.

complete.text:
Hah! Well, this is excellent news! I was starting to think that he would never be brought to justice!

Here you are, $N... and thanks. News of Arnak's foul deeds boiled my blood!

objectives.text: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

progress.text: Have you any news of that murderous Arnak Grimtotem?

complete.text: My hypercapacitor! This will keep me busy for a while until I can figure out what it does...

progress.text: Do you have my hypercapacitor?

accept.text: My brother Nataka is stationed at Ghost Walker Post over in Desolace. I'd like to ask you... could you give this report to him for me? A year has passed since the last time I wrote, there has been unusual centaur activity since then and he should be informed.$B$BJourney to Stonetalon Mountain north of the Crossroads, and then head west into Charred Vale. From there, head south into Desolace; there you will find a road going south to Ghost Walker Post.

objectives.text: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

complete.text: This is great news; I have been sitting here guarding this hunk of wood for too long. Now I can spend some time with my family... Yippee!

progress.text: You have news from Maggran Earthbinder?

accept.text: Malcin claims he is outside Razorfen Downs. This ambassador must be slain--his mission a failure in the eyes of the Lich King.$B$BHis presence there does explain much of what we've discovered about the area--some of the quilboar have grown frightfully powerful while showing signs of the Plague in their own way. Truly that must be a sign of some sort of deal they've struck.$B$BFind Malcin and slay him, $n. Return to me after the deed is done.

objectives.text: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

accept.text: My Lady,$B$BYou know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.$B$BPlease, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.$B$BBest Regards,$BAmbassador Malcin

complete.text:
I recognize the insignia on this scroll, $N. You found this on that crone who reigns over Razorfen Kraul? Interesting.

The Scourge aren't content with one continent it seems. This Ambassador Malcin--the one who wrote the note--is one of the Scourge's plagued servants, a human diplomat to the kingdom of Lordaeron before things... changed.

If the Scourge are trying to gain a foothold in Kalimdor, then it is up to us to act.

objectives.text: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

progress.text: What business is it you wish to speak of, $N? You must feel it is important if you continue to pester me.

accept.text: I recently deployed a few scouts into Ashenvale and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed.$B$BYour first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near Azshara. You will find a scout and an outrider there.$B$BGive them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.

objectives.text: Open the Bundle of Reports.  Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.

accept.text: You have brought me the book, and now it is time for your question. Are you ready?$B$BTime is not an issue, $c, so do not feel pressured. You may take as long as you like to answer.

complete.text: Well done, $c. You have studied the text I asked you to, and now you have passed another of our tests.

objectives.text: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.

accept.text: So the time is once again upon us. As a student of lore, you have shown great tenacity by undertaking my task.$B$BAnd so now I offer you your question. If you are ready, speak to me again, and take all the time you need, $n--there is no pressure to answer quickly.

complete.text: Well done, $N. I had my doubts if you studied the text I asked you to get, but you've answered correctly.

objectives.text: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the Undercity until you are ready.

I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.$B$BIf you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!

complete.text: My soothing turtle bisque will keep you warm on a cold night... if you care about that kind of thing.

accept.text:
Now that you have mastered the elements, you have an obligation to them, and thus to all of Azeroth herself. We call to them for aid, we do not demand their power. It is time you return the favors granted to you. And I think I know how.

The quilboar twist the elements for their own ends, and seem to be extending their reach within these borders. Go into their kraul and put an end to whatever they scheme. These lands must be protected.

complete.text:
Hmmph... One thing's certain. Whoever this note is from is right about their preparations going unseen. We've been too busy dealing with the centaur and harpies to send out wind riders to patrol the canyons.

You have our gratitude for alerting us to this threat, but we might still need further assistance.

objectives.text: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.

progress.text: Danger? There's been no reports of anything like that. And our wind riders are far too busy to spend their time chasing ghost stories.

accept.text:
So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.

I had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.

Take this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Twisted Fire Totems, $2oa Twisted Earth Totems, $3oa Twisted Air Totems, and $4oa Twisted Water Totems for Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.

accept.text:
The note you found says the Razormane have burrowed into the Thousand Needles for some sort of unseen ritual. Raging storms and rising tides...

The quilboar must be using some cruel sorcery they learned from Hirzek, a $c who went to great lengths to twist the elements. If they plan to flood the canyon, this would require devastating elemental powers.

We are ill equipped to deal with this, but a powerful $c like you must have an idea. Return to your allies and see if you can't find an answer.

complete.text: You have returned. Do you see the skies darkening? What news have you about the quilboar threat?

Whatever caused Dalaran's barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets.

Take the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... disagreeable point of entry.

complete.text:
It is surely no coincidence the horde has taken an interest in my city during such a precarious time.

In fact, I was counting on it. I have a proposition for you.

objectives.text: Find a way into Dalaran along the Lordamere Lake.

Stay your weapon, $r.

complete.text: Excellent work, $N. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.
Rorian sent you? Good. I could use your aid.

accept.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, $c?

complete.text: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.

objectives.text: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.

complete.text: You have returned and brought what I have requested and thus your grit and determination are unquestionable. You are ready for the next step, $N.

progress.text: The Al'Aketh cult represents the most direct and urgent danger to our homeland. Their increasingly extremist actions have destabilized our society and damaged our already-weakened connection to the spirits of the four winds. The elements demand action to prove our resilience and resolve, which are traits that are endemic to the domain of the element of earth.

accept.text:
A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few $c know the recipe.

The sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that.

Seek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass east of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need to see.

complete.text:
Ah... $N... child of the four winds... You seek understanding. You seek answers. Why have the winds left you? How may you get them back? These are answers I cannot provide, for I do not know the motives or movements of the winds.

I can, however, teach you much of the earth. Its strength, its resolve. Even here, high in this endless sea of clouds, you are still a creature of the earth. If you hope to find the strength to speak to the spirits of the four winds once more, this is the path you must walk.

objectives.text: Find the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.

accept.text:
Take this Rough Quartz from me and bring it to the one you call Windshaper Boro as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this shard will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.

Be patient, $N. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what the elements ask of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.

objectives.text: Bring the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.

complete.text:
This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.

You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, $N. Thank you.

objectives.text: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.

objectives.text: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.

complete.text:
Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.

So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?

objectives.text: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.

accept.text:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.

objectives.text: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.

complete.text:
Like a muscle, your skysight must be exercised if you hope to grow stronger in the gift. Leveraging your skysight to bridge the distance between the mortal and the spiritual may prove invaluable to you in your adventures.

You'd do well to remember what you've learned here today. Our ability to use our gifts to hear what the elements tell us could be the key to our survival.

Thank you very much for these. As elves we all have a deep connection to magic and these windstones are becoming more and more precious as the magic imbued into this island by the great anchor pylons continues to fade. 

Windstones aren't the only beneficial thing you can harvest from the land. Please, take one of these manuals.

progress.text: Hello there, $c.

accept.text:
The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.

That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!

While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.

complete.text:
A sewer key? Well, thankfully I am not the one who will be using this.

But we have work to do before it's safe to use this.

objectives.text: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

progress.text: What have you found? An ancient tome? A secret relic?

accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Shadow Protection Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

objectives.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

accept.text:
You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.

complete.text:
Oh my, a shade of the archmage? How utterly embarrassing for them.

And the Kirin Tor allowed you into their inner chambers? Interesting. This could provide an opportunity...

objectives.text: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

progress.text: You were right to come straight back to me. Have you found anything in Dalaran?

accept.text:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $n, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.

complete.text: Excellent work. That beast is unworthy to walk among the dead. Let him lie beneath them.

objectives.text: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.

accept.text:
Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.

My kinda $r!

While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.

Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?

Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.

My kinda skyborne!

While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.

Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?

complete.text:
I guess I shouldn't have sent a stooge to look for priceless artifacts. This is barely worth sellin' at a tourist kiosk! What, did you just grab the first book that seemed to be jutting out from the rest?

Forget it. Maybe I can spray it with gold and say it belonged to an arch mage or somethin'.

objectives.text: Collect the Founding of Dalaran from the City of Dalaran for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.

progress.text: Well? Didja find their library? There's gotta be somethin' good in there.

accept.text:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.

complete.text:
Cracked. Cracked. CRACKED.

I can't make use of any of these! I said disable the sentries, not obliterate them! How dangerous could they have been?

My dreams of magus abominations are at a standstill. For now.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.

progress.text: The value in these cores is that they are powerful. The downside is that means the constructs are powerful. Good luck.

accept.text:
You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.

As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?

Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.

complete.text:
You would give this... willingly?

I do not know your game, $r, but I cannot deny the value of your interference during this delicate time for our people. It's not within my power to grant you access to the city at this time, but someday... perhaps. For now, our thanks will have to suffice.

objectives.text: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera near Dalaran.

progress.text: Oh, you are back.

accept.text:
Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.

I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!

Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.

complete.text:
Excellent! I can hardly contain my excitement. Oh, and the heart still has electrical pulses? That's impressive. I won't have to shock it back to life then!

This heart will be a wonderful addition to the abomination, and certainly looks to be the specified size, if these notes are correct.

Ah, I love it when a plan comes together.

objectives.text: Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.

progress.text: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your flesh and organs would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.

accept.text:
Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.

complete.text: Thank you, $N. These supplies will help get us through until the next shipment arrives.

objectives.text: Bring 8 Stolen Freewind Supplies to Jandia in Freewind Post.

progress.text: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?

accept.text:
The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.

complete.text: This is wonderful news! I will send word to our suppliers that the harpies have been dealt with. At least that is one less threat the future caravans will need to worry about.

objectives.text: Slay 5 Screeching Harpies, 5 Screeching Roguefeather Harpies and 5 Screeching Windcaller Harpies.
